expect_error.description: parser rejects this file: [found ''\''' at 26..27 expected ''s'', ''S'', ''l'', ''L'', ''_'', ''d'', ''D'', or end of input]. Spec: the file violates the CIF syntax rules recorded in docs/ground-truth.md.

known_gap_note: The file uses VT (0x0B) and FF (0x0C) as end-of-line characters (pre-1.1 'translated EOL' practice; CIF 1.1 removed both from the allowed set). Our lexer's EOL set is CR and LF only. The upstream parser drives this test with an explicit eol option.
